entities.title: Hyperspace
entities.summary: The selected system, the hyperspace and Reach-drive keys, the countdown, the jump and the arrival.
entities.purpose: Holds the state between the universe's pure computations (cursor, selection, current system and countdown) and makes the draws of RULES A.5, B.16 and C.16.6 in order, including the mis-jump into the Deep.
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
It returns a Tunnel and an Arrived for the use case to act on; it does not run the tunnel or the modes.
